name: Main Process
description: Electron main process entry point. Creates frameless BrowserWindows (1440x900, contextIsolation, sandboxed), registers 40+ IPC handlers for filesystem operations, node-pty terminal sessions (multi-session, platform-aware shell detection), git operations via CLI execFile, workspace persistence (.cockpit/window.json), user preferences (preferences.json in userData), chokidar file watching with 100ms debounce, clipboard access, and multi-window support. Enforces workspace path sandboxing via isPathSafe().

security.path_sandbox: isPathSafe() enforces all FS operations stay within workspace root
security.env_filter: filterEnv() allows only 20+ whitelisted env keys (PATH, HOME, etc.)
security.navigation: will-navigate prevented, window.open denied, zoom locked

lifecycle.shutdown: window-all-closed → stopWatching() → kill all PTYs → quit (non-macOS)
lifecycle.multi_window: window:new creates independent BrowserWindow, window:close cleans up per-window terminals
